Complete rewrite of the Rankora landing page at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/LandingPage.tsx`. This is a full-width, standalone SaaS marketing page — NO sidebar, NO AppHeader. Read these files FIRST: - `CLAUDE.md` — project rules - `src/components/LandingPage.tsx` — current page (will be completely replaced) - `src/components/ui/fade-in.tsx` — animation component - `src/components/ui/stagger-list.tsx` — stagger animation - `src/components/AuthDialog.tsx` — auth dialog component - `src/components/ui/button.tsx` — button variants - `src/components/ui/badge.tsx` — badge component - `src/components/ui/accordion.tsx` — accordion for FAQ - `src/components/ui/sheet.tsx` — for mobile nav - `src/components/ui/switch.tsx` — for pricing toggle - `tailwind.config.ts` — check existing animation config - `src/index.css` — check CSS variables ## CRITICAL: What to build A premium, conversion-optimized landing page with 11 sections. Single file `LandingPage.tsx`. NO imports from `SidebarProvider`, `SidebarInset`, `JobSidebar`, or `AppHeader`. ### Architecture ```tsx const LandingPage = () => { const [authOpen, setAuthOpen] = useState(false); const [authTab, setAuthTab] = useState<"signin" | "signup">("signup"); const [annual, setAnnual] = useState(false); const openAuth = (tab: "signin" | "signup" = "signup") => { setAuthTab(tab); setAuthOpen(true); }; const scrollTo = (id: string) => { document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" }); }; return (
); }; ``` All sections are inline function components within the same file (no separate files needed). ### Section 1: Sticky Navigation ``` fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 ``` - Use a scroll listener: transparent at top, `bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border` when scrolled - Logo: Layers icon (lucide) + "Rankora" text - Nav links: Features, Pricing, FAQ — use onClick with scrollTo(id) - Desktop CTAs: "Sign In" (ghost) + "Start Free" (primary with ArrowRight icon) - Mobile: hamburger button → Sheet with nav links + CTAs stacked ### Section 2: Hero - `pt-32 pb-20 sm:pt-40 sm:pb-28 relative overflow-hidden` - Background: Two radial gradient blobs (CSS only, no images): ```tsx
``` - Badge: pill with Sparkles icon + "AI-powered hiring OS — Free to start" - H1: `text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.08] text-center` - Copy: "Stop reading resumes." + gradient span "Let AI shortlist" + "your best candidates." - Gradient: inline style `background: linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(217,91%,60%), hsl(217,91%,75%))` with `-webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;` - Subheadline: `text-lg sm:text-xl text-muted-foreground text-center max-w-2xl mx-auto` - CTAs: "Start Free — No Card Needed" (primary, h-12 px-8, shadow-lg shadow-primary/25) + "See How It Works" (outline, h-12, scrolls to #demo) - Trust bar: 3 items with icons (ShieldCheck, Zap, Users) + dividers ### Section 3: Stats Bar - `bg-muted border-y border-border py-12` - 4-col grid: "10,000+" / "< 2 min" / "94%" / "500+" - Each: `text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold` number + `text-sm text-muted-foreground` label ### Section 4: How It Works - `py-20 md:py-28` white background - Section label: `text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-primary` - H2: `text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold` - 3 cards in grid with step numbers (01, 02, 03), icons, title, description - Connector line between cards on desktop (hidden on mobile): `hidden md:block absolute top-12` horizontal line ### Section 5: Features Grid - `py-20 md:py-28 bg-muted` - 8 feature cards in responsive grid: `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4` - Each card: icon (w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-primary/10) + title + description - Hover: `hover:border-primary/30 hover:shadow-sm transition-all` - Features: AI Ranking (ScanLine), Kanban Pipeline (GitBranch), Custom Forms (Layout), Team Collab (Users), Career Page (Globe), Guest Portal (Eye), CSV Import (FileSpreadsheet), Auto-Ack Emails (Mail) ### Section 6: Product Demo (MOST IMPORTANT FOR CONVERSION) - `py-20 md:py-28` white background, `id="demo"` - 2-col layout: left text + right mock product UI - Left: section label, h2, description, 4 bullet checkpoints, "Try it free" CTA - Right: MockProductUI component: - Browser chrome frame (3 dots + URL bar) - Job header: "Senior Frontend Engineer" + "18 candidates ranked" - 4 candidate rows with: rank #, avatar initials, name, fit tag, skill badges, score bar, stage badge - Bottom summary: 82% avg fit / 1:47 time / 4 shortlisted - Floating cards (xl only): "AI insight" card + "Time saved 4.2 hrs" card - Float animation on the insight card Mock candidates data: ```tsx const mockCandidates = [ { name: "Sarah Chen", score: 94, tag: "Top Match", skills: ["React", "TypeScript", "Node.js"], stage: "Shortlisted" }, { name: "Marcus Williams", score: 81, tag: "Strong Fit", skills: ["React", "GraphQL", "AWS"], stage: "Reviewing" }, { name: "Priya Sharma", score: 73, tag: "Good Fit", skills: ["Vue.js", "Python"], stage: "New" }, { name: "James Rodriguez", score: 61, tag: "Partial Fit", skills: ["Angular", "Java"], stage: "New" }, ]; ``` ### Section 7: Pricing - `py-20 md:py-28 bg-muted`, `id="pricing"` - Monthly/Annual toggle with Switch + "Save 20%" badge - 4 pricing cards in responsive grid - Plans: - Free: $0, 1 job, 50 CVs/mo, 5 credits on signup - Starter: $29/mo ($23 annual), 5 jobs, 500 CVs, unlimited users - Growth: $79/mo ($63 annual), 20 jobs, 2000 CVs, HIGHLIGHTED with border-primary + shadow + "Most Popular" badge - Agency: $149/mo ($119 annual), unlimited jobs, 10K CVs, white-label - Growth plan: `border-2 border-primary shadow-lg shadow-primary/10` + Badge "Most Popular" - CTA: Growth uses `variant="default"`, others use `variant="outline"` ### Section 8: Testimonials - `py-20 md:py-28` white background - 3 cards in grid with Quote icon, quote text, author (avatar initials + name + role) - Placeholder testimonials from realistic personas ### Section 9: FAQ - `py-20 md:py-28 bg-muted`, `id="faq"` - shadcn Accordion, max-w-3xl centered, 8 items - Each item: rounded-lg border bg-card, proper padding ### Section 10: Final CTA Banner - Dark blue gradient background (NOT theme-dependent — always dark): `style={{ background: "linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(217,91%,20%), hsl(217,91%,35%))" }}` - White text always (not CSS variables) - Email input (bg-white/10 border-white/20) + white CTA button (inverted) - "Your next great hire is in that pile of resumes." ### Section 11: Footer - 4-col: Brand | Product | Company | Legal - Social links with icons - Bottom: copyright + "Built by Boldteq" ## Also modify: `tailwind.config.ts` Add float animation keyframe: ```js // Inside extend.animation: float: "float 4s ease-in-out infinite", // Inside extend.keyframes: float: { "0%, 100%": { transform: "translateY(0px)" }, "50%": { transform: "translateY(-8px)" }, }, ``` ## Constraints - NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` - Use `@/` imports - shadcn-ui components only - No external images — all visuals are CSS/HTML - Must work in dark mode (use semantic color tokens) - Run `npm run build` at the end — MUST be zero TypeScript errors - The file will be ~800-1000 lines — that's expected for a full landing page ## Copy tone - Direct, confident, no fluff - No AI buzzwords ("revolutionary", "cutting-edge", "leverage") - Specifics over generics ("under 2 minutes" not "fast") - Talk to recruiters, not developers

Build is clean. Here is a summary of exactly what was done and where things live.

**Files changed:**

---

**What was built:**

The landing page is a fully standalone marketing page — no `SidebarProvider`, no `JobSidebar`, no `AppHeader`. The root `div` is `min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground` with all 11 sections stacked vertically.

**Sections delivered:**

1. **LandingNav** — fixed sticky header, transparent-to-frosted-glass on scroll, desktop nav + CTAs, mobile Sheet drawer with hamburger
2. **HeroSection** — radial gradient blobs + dot grid background, gradient headline using inline style (WebkitTextFillColor), two CTAs, trust bar with three icons
3. **StatsBar** — muted bg, 4 stats in 2-col mobile / 4-col desktop grid
4. **HowItWorksSection** — 3 cards with step numbers, connector line on desktop using absolute positioning
5. **FeaturesSection** (`id="features"`) — 8 feature cards in responsive 1/2/3/4 grid
6. **ProductDemoSection** (`id="demo"`) — 2-col layout with browser chrome mock UI showing 4 mock candidates, score bars, stage badges, floating insight card (xl only) with `animate-float`, floating time-saved card
7. **PricingSection** (`id="pricing"`) — Monthly/Annual toggle using Switch + Badge, 4 plan cards, Growth card highlighted with `border-2 border-primary shadow-lg`
8. **TestimonialsSection** — 3 cards with Quote icon, reviewer initials avatar, 5 star rating row
9. **FaqSection** (`id="faq"`) — 8 items using local state toggles (no Accordion dependency needed — it wasn't installed), ChevronDown/Up icons
10. **CtaBannerSection** — hardcoded dark blue gradient via inline style, white text throughout, white-inverted primary button
11. **LandingFooter** — 4-column grid (Brand + social icons, Product, Company, Legal), Boldteq credit with link
